@about: The MEP drafting add-on's words (2D building-services drafting). Terms: run, service, single line, double line, nominal size (DN), duct, elbow, damper, tag, legend, schedule.
cmd.mepservice.help: List the services, choose the one new runs are drawn in, or add your own
cmd.mepscale.help: Set the drawing scale that symbols and tag text are sized for
cmd.meppipe.help: Draw a pipe run on its service layer: single line or double line at the real outside diameter
cmd.mepduct.help: Draw a duct run: rectangular by width, round by diameter, or flexible as a wavy line
cmd.mepsym.help: Put a valve or accessory on a run: it breaks the line, aligns to it and gets a tag
cmd.mepequip.help: Place equipment in plan: radiator, fan coil, air handling unit, boiler, chiller, tank, heat exchanger, air terminals
cmd.meptag.help: Change the tag of a symbol or equipment, or number every tag again in reading order
cmd.mepsizetag.help: Write a run's size and service along it
cmd.mepflow.help: Put a flow arrow on a run
cmd.meplegend.help: Place or update a legend of the services, symbols and equipment used in the drawing
cmd.mepsched.help: Count symbols and equipment by kind, size and service, and place or update the count as a table
cmd.mepselect.help: Select every piece of the run you click
ask.service: Service tag to draw in (pipes {cur}, ducts {duct}), ? for the list, A to add one
ask.service.tag: Tag of the new service (letters and digits, up to 8, for example LTHW)
ask.service.name: Its name
ask.service.linetype: Linetype (Continuous, DASHED, DASHDOT, CENTER, HIDDEN, DOT …)
ask.run.first: First point of the run ({what}); start on a connection point or on a run to branch from it
ask.run.next: Next point ({what}); end on a connection point or on a run to join it
ask.pipe.size.mm: Size: DN15 to DN600, or an outside diameter as Ø22
ask.pipe.size.in: Nominal size in inches (1/2, 3/4, 1, 1-1/4 …), or an outside diameter in millimetres as Ø22
ask.duct.size: Width x height in {unit} (the plan shows the width)
ask.sym.place: Click a run where the {sym} goes (or an empty place to put it down free)
ask.tag.pick: Click a symbol or equipment to change its tag
ask.sizetag: Click a run where its size tag goes
ask.flow: Click a run where the flow arrow goes
ask.select: Click any piece of a run
ask.update: The {what} is already in the drawing: Update it or place a New one
ask.place: Where the {what} goes (its top left corner)
done.service: New runs are drawn as {tag}, {name}, on layer {layer}.
done.scale: Scale 1:{n}: symbols are {sym} long and tag text {text} high, in drawing units.
done.run: Run {what} drawn on layer {layer}: {len} long, {n} objects.
done.placed: {what} placed. Run the command again to update it.
err.service.tag: A service tag is letters and digits, starting with a letter, up to 8.
err.service.unknown: No service {tag}. Type ? in MEPSERVICE for the list.
err.scale: A scale is a number, for example 50 for 1:50.
err.pipe.size: That size does not read. Steel pipe sizes come from the table; type any other pipe as its outside diameter, for example Ø22.
err.duct.size: That size does not read. Rectangular: 400x250. Round: 200.
err.run: The run needs two different points.
err.run.long: A run has at most 200 points.
err.sym.unknown: No symbol {name}. Type ? for the list.
err.sym.pipe: That is a pipe symbol and this is a duct run.
err.sym.duct: That is a duct symbol and this is a pipe run.
err.sym.short: This straight piece is too short for the {sym}.
err.eq.unknown: No equipment {name}. Type ? for the list.
err.eq.size: That size does not read. Type millimetres, for example 1000 or 1000x100.
err.tag.notours: That is not an MEP symbol or equipment.
err.notrun: There is no pipe or duct run there.
err.nothing: Nothing to list yet: draw runs and place symbols first.
legend.title: Legend
sched.title: MEP schedule
panel.facts: {runs} runs, {items} symbols and equipment. Drawing in {svc} (pipes) and {duct} (ducts) at 1:{n}.
panel.none: Nothing drawn yet: type MEPPIPE or MEPDUCT.
